body:
While the owner is travelling (2026-09-04..09-14) an omitted per-repo decision approves the converged candidates (`approved_candidates: all`) instead of deferring, so the weekly review pipeline keeps filing implementation work. Measured need: the fleet completes about 5 implementation issues a day (60-day window, trackers and campaigns excluded); with `defer` it runs dry within a day of the last recorded decision. The evaluator's quality validation still gates every issue body. `defaults.window_note` records when to revert to `defer`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
